name: Carnal Christian
overview: Scripture clearly distinguishes between living according to the flesh and living according to the Spirit. Those who are in Christ are called to be dead to sin and to walk not after the flesh but after the Spirit, for the flesh cannot please God. The conflict between the flesh and the Spirit makes it impossible to fulfill the desires of both, emphasizing the necessity of the Spirit of God dwelling within believers. As followers of God and His dear children, Christians are called to live in the Spirit, not in the flesh.
